There's a README and a small src/ tree. Reading the README now.

This is **ledger-cli**, a small command-line expense tracker that keeps entries in a plain-text file you can edit and diff by hand.

- `src/index.js` is the entry point: it parses argv and dispatches to one of the commands in `src/commands/` (`add`, `list`, `total`).
- `src/parser.js` turns each ledger line into a typed entry, storing amounts as integer cents so totals never drift.
- Tests live in `test/` and run with `node --test`.

Try it with `node src/index.js add "coffee 4.50" --tag food`.
